about: Source of truth for every Krea-generated 3D model. Fable adds entries as models are made; tools/krea_assets.py turns this into public/props/krea/manifest.json (optimised GLBs + thumbnails). Raw files live outside the repo in ../../Refs/krea3d/<id>_raw.glb, <id>_preview.png (Hunyuan render), <id>_ref.png (Krea reference image).

models.name: Myrtle Av-Broadway station house
models.description: Mezzanine, glass-block elevator tower and street stair of the J/M/Z station, from Wikimedia Commons photos.

models.name: Platform section with canopy
models.description: 12 m covered side platform: green steel canopy on bracketed columns, yellow tactile edge, bench. Tiled 60 m at Myrtle.

models.name: Open platform section
models.description: 12 m open side platform: double-globe lamp post, picket fence, concrete-cased column. Tiled at both platform ends.

models.name: Elevated structure bent
models.description: One section of the riveted green steel el over Broadway, repeated along the whole J route.

models.name: Bushwick corner tenement
models.description: Three-storey brick tenement with cornice, fire escapes and a shop at street level. Fitted to the nearest 3-storey footprints.

models.name: Corner fast-food block
models.description: One-storey corner block with three storefronts and roof units, on the footprint across from the station.
